page.title: Delivery
page.description:
Online Delivery Policy:

For online purchase Regal Furniture is committed to deliver its product within 72 hours (For stocked product). Friday and other holiday is not included within this time. If product is not available in stock, it will take 10-15 working days to deliver.

Two different delivery policy is applicable for Dhaka and Outside Dhaka.

Delivery Location Order Amount Delivery Charge
Inside Dhaka 3000 tk or above Free
Inside Dhaka Less than 3000 tk 200
Outside Dhaka 5000 tk or above Free
Outside Dhaka Less than 5000 tk 300


Regal Emporium Delivery Policy:

Regal Emporium will provide free home delivery for a minimum purchase amount of 20,000 taka. For less than 20,000 taka, Delivery charge is not fixed. It depands on the distance between showroom location to customer address.
 

Note: We deliver our product from our factory in a 5-ton truck. So our vehicle will only go where a 5-ton truck can reach.
